faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to your questions
faq.q1: How does FranceJustice NGO ensure legal accuracy?
faq.a1: All algorithms and templates are supervised by Dr. Imam Çoban (Doctor of Law) and CNB certified lawyers.
faq.a2: Yes, all videoconferences and messages are end-to-end encrypted under attorney-client privilege (Loi 1971).
faq.q3: Can I access legal information for free?
faq.a3: Absolutely. Essential legal search and basic document templates are 100% free under our NGO pro bono mission.
faq.q4: How do I get a certified diploma or masterclass certificate?
faq.a4: Enroll in our virtual classrooms directed by law university professors and pass the validated online assessments.
faq.q5: Is my data stored securely according to RGPD?
faq.a5: Yes, we use PostgreSQL TLS 1.3, AES-256 encryption, and automatic CNIL retention purge schedules.
